claim: Modelled parked-time budget per analyses/M686_spec.md Rev 1.1 (read sections 3, 4, 9). Reproduce independently from drive_master.csv, seasonal_drive_master.csv (utc_offset_h, ambient_start_c, ambient_end_c, unlogged_distance_est_km, local_iso) and the raw drive CSVs in raw/ (names with spaces map to drive_master.csv file keys by digits). Do not read tools/parked_time_budget.py or the parkedTimeBudget payload block. Pack temperature at a drive end/start = mean over probes T1..T4 of each probe's last/first valid reading (range -40..90 C) within 60 s of the drive's last/first timestamp, at least 3 of 4 probes else missing (column renames: compute_drive_summary_v6.COL_MAP). Drives sorted by UTC key-on = local_iso[:19] minus utc_offset_h; key-off = key-on + duration_s. Gap = next key-on minus previous key-off (hours); assigned when the previous end pack temperature and both ambients exist and the gap is not negative. T(t)=A+(T0-A)exp(-t/tau), A=(previous ambient_end_c + next ambient_start_c)/2, tau=7.873 h (primary). Bands <0,0-5,...,35-40,>=40 (an edge value goes to the upper band). Report the exact band hours of the assigned gaps.
secondClaim: Endpoint check: for the gap classes 'below 1 h' (n 341) and '12 to <36 h' (n 75), predicted next key-on pack temperature with the primary tau 7.873 h (no cross-validation needed for this check) against the observed next-drive start pack temperature; report MAE of the model, of persistence (T0) and of full relaxation (A).
